noncomputable def repSum (P : ℕ → Prop) (N : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n₁ ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ n₂ ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ n₃ ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
    if n₁ + n₂ + n₃ = N ∧ P n₁ ∧ P n₂ ∧ P n₃ then
      Λ n₁ * Λ n₂ * Λ n₃ * etaPlus (n₁ / xOf N) * etaPlus (n₂ / xOf N) *
        etaStar (n₃ / xOf N)
    else 0
